title.en: MALACANANG DESIGNATING THE HEAD OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT-INTERNAL AUDIT OFFICE (OP-IAO) AS ADDITIONAL MEMBER OF THE PRESIDENTIAL ANTI-GRAFT

text.en:
The Head of the Office of the President-Internal Audit Office
(OP-IAO) shall be an ex-officio member of the Presidential Anti-Graft Commission

All executive orders, rules, regulations, and other issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are
hereby repealed, amended or otherwise modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 27th day of March, 2009.
Marie Mr. hire
47910;
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
Prilla Holouram * 47910
